长春龙嘉.source_text_en: Taxi-through (idle) de-icing: Taxi to the de-icing position near the RWY 24 threshold. After the follow-me car departs, stop by observing the stop line on your own — it ishard to see atnight or when covered with snow. Contact the de-icing controller if the position is uncertain. Crews should complete de-icing/anti-icing preparations, maintain the de-icing configuration, and contact the de-icing controller. The taxiway centerline lights on the de-icing pad are hard to observe — be careful while taxiing. The holdover time for taxi-through de-icing may be short; time the de-icing appropriately and monitor the takeoff time.

扬州泰州.source_text_zh: 进场：当本场向北运行时，从奔牛(ZJ)方向进港如遇军方活 动常州塔台可能指挥ZJ前下高度2400米并且ZJ后飞YA206，后续换频联系扬州塔台后指挥保持高度过YA206后飞YA107、YA104接35号盲降。期间过YA206才能下降并要求YA107前到 达900米。通过900米后才可以右转飞YA104。YA104前塔台可 能指挥可以35号盲降，转五边自行掌握建立报告。机组应注 意减速和切五边时机。

长春龙嘉.source_text_en: On RWY 24 departures, ATC may require reaching 1,500 m before CC503. However, CC503 is the IF for the RWY 06 approach and is not included in the RWY 24 departure procedure. Crews should be aware, and may consider entering this point via the FIX INFO function for reference.

长春龙嘉.source_text_en: Taxi-through (idle) de-icing: Taxi to the de-icing position near the RWY 24 threshold. After the follow-me car departs, stop by observing the stop line on your own — it ishard to see atnight or when covered with snow. Contact the de-icing controller if the position is uncertain. Crews should complete de-icing/anti-icing preparations, maintain the de-icing configuration, and contact the de-icing controller. The taxiway centerline lights on the de-icing pad are hard to observe — be careful while taxiing. The holdover time for taxi-through de-icing may be short; time the de-icing appropriately and monitor the takeoff time.
长春龙嘉.source_heading: 长春龙嘉机场运行特点 ZYCC/CGQ

长春龙嘉.source_text_zh: 运行特点：慢车除冰:滑到24号跑道头附近除冰位，引导车脱离后，需要自己观察 stop 线停下，晚上有雪覆盖较难看到。不确定位置时和除冰指挥联系。机组做好 除防冰准备，保持除冰构型，联系除防冰指挥。除冰坪的滑行中线灯不容易 观察，滑行时需要注意。慢车除冰保持时间可能较短，需把握除冰时机并关 注起飞时间。

长春龙嘉.text_zh: 慢车除冰:滑到24号跑道头附近除冰位，引导车脱离后，需要自己观察 stop 线停下，晚上有雪覆盖较难看到。不确定位置时和除冰指挥联系。机组做好 除防冰准备，保持除冰构型，联系除防冰指挥。除冰坪的滑行中线灯不容易 观察，滑行时需要注意。慢车除冰保持时间可能较短，需把握除冰时机并关 注起飞时间。
长春龙嘉.text_en: Taxi-through (idle) de-icing: Taxi to the de-icing position near the RWY 24 threshold. After the follow-me car departs, stop by observing the stop line on your own — it ishard to see atnight or when covered with snow. Contact the de-icing controller if the position is uncertain. Crews should complete de-icing/anti-icing preparations, maintain the de-icing configuration, and contact the de-icing controller. The taxiway centerline lights on the de-icing pad are hard to observe — be careful while taxiing. The holdover time for taxi-through de-icing may be short; time the de-icing appropriately and monitor the takeoff time.

长春龙嘉.source_text_en: RWY 24 arrivals areusually cleared via the LEMOT-9A (or possibly LEMOT-7A /LEMOT-8A), with direct-to CC455 or CC608. In cold weather, ATC may clear a descent to 1,000 m to establish the RWY 24 ILS.

长春龙嘉.source_text_en: When arriving from the LEMOT or IDVOT direction, ATC issues the LEMOT- 9A arrival;the MCDU displays it as"LEMO9A." Read back correctly and do not read back "LEMOT-09A," so as to reduce frequency occupancy caused by ATC corrections.

长春龙嘉.source_text_en: The runway islower at the east end and higher at the west end, with a noticeable gradient: RWY 24 has upslope gradients of 0.5% and 0.7%, and RWY 06 has downslope gradients of 0.5% and 0.7%. Be aware of the effect on visual references during landing, especially on RWY 24 in the afternoon when landing into the sun.

扬州泰州.text: 当本场向北运行时，从奔牛(ZJ)方向进港如遇军方活 动常州塔台可能指挥ZJ前下高度2400米并且ZJ后飞YA206，后续换频联系扬州塔台后指挥保持高度过YA206后飞YA107、YA104接35号盲降。期间过YA206才能下降并要求YA107前到 达900米。通过900米后才可以右转飞YA104。YA104前塔台可 能指挥可以35号盲降，转五边自行掌握建立报告。机组应注 意减速和切五边时机。

长春龙嘉.text: 慢车除冰:滑到24号跑道头附近除冰位，引导车脱离后，需要自己观察 stop 线停下，晚上有雪覆盖较难看到。不确定位置时和除冰指挥联系。机组做好 除防冰准备，保持除冰构型，联系除防冰指挥。除冰坪的滑行中线灯不容易 观察，滑行时需要注意。慢车除冰保持时间可能较短，需把握除冰时机并关 注起飞时间。

zh.source_text_zh: 进场：当本场向北运行时，从奔牛(ZJ)方向进港如遇军方活 动常州塔台可能指挥ZJ前下高度2400米并且ZJ后飞YA206，后续换频联系扬州塔台后指挥保持高度过YA206后飞YA107、YA104接35号盲降。期间过YA206才能下降并要求YA107前到 达900米。通过900米后才可以右转飞YA104。YA104前塔台可 能指挥可以35号盲降，转五边自行掌握建立报告。机组应注 意减速和切五边时机。

zh.source_heading: 扬州/泰州机场运行特点
zh.source_section: 扬州/泰州机场运行特点／核心威胁与运行特点
zh.source_text_zh: 进场：35 号跑道从北边 NIXEM 进场，三边时，塔台经常会 指挥可以自主建立五边航道，五边后可以下高度 600 建立 盲降，但如果按要求提前转弯的话很可能会高截获，鉴于此，有机组报告出现过航向道不稳定事件，故建议机组留好五 边距离的余度，掌握切入时机，做好预案，注意监控飞机参 数，出现非预期情况，及时干预。

zh.source_text_en: On RWY 24 departures, ATC may require reaching 1,500 m before CC503. However, CC503 is the IF for the RWY 06 approach and is not included in the RWY 24 departure procedure. Crews should be aware, and may consider entering this point via the FIX INFO function for reference.

zh.source_text_en: Taxi-through (idle) de-icing: Taxi to the de-icing position near the RWY 24 threshold. After the follow-me car departs, stop by observing the stop line on your own — it ishard to see atnight or when covered with snow. Contact the de-icing controller if the position is uncertain. Crews should complete de-icing/anti-icing preparations, maintain the de-icing configuration, and contact the de-icing controller. The taxiway centerline lights on the de-icing pad are hard to observe — be careful while taxiing. The holdover time for taxi-through de-icing may be short; time the de-icing appropriately and monitor the takeoff time.

zh.source_text_zh: 运行特点：慢车除冰:滑到24号跑道头附近除冰位，引导车脱离后，需要自己观察 stop 线停下，晚上有雪覆盖较难看到。不确定位置时和除冰指挥联系。机组做好 除防冰准备，保持除冰构型，联系除防冰指挥。除冰坪的滑行中线灯不容易 观察，滑行时需要注意。慢车除冰保持时间可能较短，需把握除冰时机并关 注起飞时间。

zh.source_text_en: On RWY 06 approaches, due to other users' activity,ATC sometimes requires maintaining 2,100 m until15 nm DME. Prepare inadvance for ahigh interception — slow down and configure early. Pay special attention to avoiding being unstable at1,000 ft.

zh.source_text_zh: 进场：06号跑道进近时，因其他用户活动，有时要求保持 2100m 至 DME15 海里，请机组提前做好高截获预案，提前减速、放形态。须特别注意，避免 1000 英尺未稳定。

zh.source_text_en: RWY 24 arrivals areusually cleared via the LEMOT-9A (or possibly LEMOT-7A /LEMOT-8A), with direct-to CC455 or CC608. In cold weather, ATC may clear a descent to 1,000 m to establish the RWY 24 ILS.

zh.source_text_en: When arriving from the LEMOT or IDVOT direction, ATC issues the LEMOT- 9A arrival;the MCDU displays it as"LEMO9A." Read back correctly and do not read back "LEMOT-09A," so as to reduce frequency occupancy caused by ATC corrections.
zh.source_heading: 长春龙嘉机场运行特点 ZYCC/CGQ

zh.source_text_zh: 进场：当从 LEMOT 或 IDVOT 方向进场时，管制发布 LEMOT-9A 进场指令，MCDU 显示 为 LEMO9A，请机组正确复诵，不要复诵成 LEMOT-09A，以减少因管制纠正 指令而占用波道。

zh.source_text_en: On RNP approaches, ATC direct-toclearances may easily resultin failing to meet the charted altitude constraint before the FDP; after arming APPR, failure to capture FINAL APP may occur. Crews should manage the vertical profile carefully.

zh.source_text_en: The runway islower at the east end and higher at the west end, with a noticeable gradient: RWY 24 has upslope gradients of 0.5% and 0.7%, and RWY 06 has downslope gradients of 0.5% and 0.7%. Be aware of the effect on visual references during landing, especially on RWY 24 in the afternoon when landing into the sun.

zh.source_text_en: Spring operations: Cyclonic activity isfrequent, manifesting as strong winds and blowing sand with large variations in wind direction and speed, increasing the difficulty of controlling takeoffs and landings. Visibility is low on blowing-sand days with poor visual references, and wind shear risk exists.

en.source_text_en: Taxi-through (idle) de-icing: Taxi to the de-icing position near the RWY 24 threshold. After the follow-me car departs, stop by observing the stop line on your own — it ishard to see atnight or when covered with snow. Contact the de-icing controller if the position is uncertain. Crews should complete de-icing/anti-icing preparations, maintain the de-icing configuration, and contact the de-icing controller. The taxiway centerline lights on the de-icing pad are hard to observe — be careful while taxiing. The holdover time for taxi-through de-icing may be short; time the de-icing appropriately and monitor the takeoff time.

Visibility is low on blowing-sand days with poor visual references, and wind shear risk exists.

扬州泰州.source_text_zh: 2021年7 月9C6552 珠海-扬州航班。在扬州进近前，塔 台临时指挥机组执行 35 号跑道进近着陆，因一边有17 号起 飞的飞机，指挥下高度比较晚，但在高度1000 英尺未能截获 下滑道，继续进近至 400 英尺左右决策复飞，复飞后再次建立 35 号盲降，后续正常。
